lines: Each Sister possesses one of four personality types which determine what quotes they use.
**After completing The War Within and Call of the Tempestarii**
- Parvos Granum: "My brother was a witless man. Happy as a hog, face-down in the trough. No thought of the farmer's axe."
- Parvos Granum: "He was a brute above my asperous constitution. Yet he had not the will nor the guile to let me guide that brawn."
- Parvos Granum: "So... in my youth, I often imagined I had another sibling. A specter... of sorts. A sister."
- Parvos Granum: "And in my mind, she and I - oh, how we would conspire... great schemes, risk-trades, rapacious plots."
- Parvos Granum: "And should I ever find myself... back at the trough. Penniless. Betrayed. Rich, only in enemies..."
- Parvos Granum: "She'd be at my side, axe in hand."
> During a routine electromagnetic wave sweep, a most distressing message was intercepted on the Corpus network. Ordis hopes nothing comes of this murderous consortium, or rather, board meeting.
- Vala Glarios: "Parvos Granum! This next candidate claims she shed the bonds of idleness and aspires to become your sister."
- Vala Glarios: "Candidate, you would be wise to remember your Tenets. Brother Parvos is watching."
- Vala Glarios: "Candidate, your accomplishments are many. Now prove yourself to our brother, Parvos Granum."
- Vala Glarios: "Brother! Another candidate steps forward in the hope of admission to our Sisterhood."
- Parvos Granum: "You have proved yourself many times over. Let us see if you have steel in you."
- Parvos Granum: "This one is now alone. Friendless. Desperate. As I once was."
- Parvos Granum: "There is but one true test. Be the reaper, or be the crop."
- Parvos Granum: "We are all marked to die in the end. Some cower, some fight. Which are you?"
- Parvos Granum: "If you mean to rise from the decadent morass the Corpus has become, prove yourself to me."
- Parvos Granum: "You are to be split, little stone. I shall see whether your core is diamond... or dross."
- Parvos Granum: "Sister. Chosen by fate. Purged by death. Worthy as few are worthy."
- Parvos Granum: "This moment defines you. Remember it with every screaming nerve."
- Parvos Granum: "My Sisters, we have a neonate! Induct her at once!"
- Parvos Granum: "Death has embraced you once. But now, you are my Sister. It will not dare do so again."
- Parvos Granum: "Embrace the pain! It is the birth pang of your power!"
- Parvos Granum: "Perhaps we can find something for you. In filing."
- Parvos Granum: "The Void hides many mistakes. So be it."
- Parvos Granum: "Some errors serve to inform. Some merely insult the maker."
- Parvos Granum: "You have mistaken your desire."
- Parvos Granum: "Get this inadequate out of my sight."
- Vala Glarios: "She eluded the Tenno. A strong candidate, but this was not her time."
- Vala Glarios: "The Tenno was too weak for her. We shall find her a more suitable match."
- Vala Glarios: "A draw! Impressive. Reward the candidate and return her to the queue."
- Vala Glarios: "Our candidate escaped. How embarrassing for the Tenno."
- Vala Glarios: "This Tenno is wasting your time Brother Parvos. The candidate has eluded them."
- Vala Glarios: "We came to judge this candidate, but instead, she judged this Tenno unworthy."
- Vala Glarios: "Sister. You have been... promoted."
- Vala Glarios: "You have proven true Sister. A promotion is in order."
- Vala Glarios: "When a Sister distinguishes herself, she deserves... promotion.""'
- Vala Glarios: "I hereby promote you in rank and power. Use it."
- Vala Glarios: "Sister, we honor you with promotion to the highest rank!"
- Vala Glarios: "You now receive the highest honor the Sisterhood can bestow!"
- Vala Glarios: "This is Sister Vala Glarios. Dispatching fleet support. We stand with you."
- Vala Glarios: "Sister, you have our Brother's full support. Take what is yours."
- Vala Glarios: "Hold fast, Sister. Honor those who have gone before you!"
- Vala Glarios: "Have faith Sister! When your time comes your Sisters shall sing! But your time is not yet."
- Vala Glarios: "Authorizing protective specter deployment. I shall not lose another of my Sisters."
- Vala Glarios: "Sister, your desire has been rewarded with protection from Brother Parvos. Deploying specters. May they be your shields!"
- Vala Glarios: "Fight well Sister. Parvos send you guardian specters. Turn the strength of the Tenno back against them!"
- Vala Glarios: "Specters, stand by my Sister and shield her from all harm!"
- Vala Glarios: "Specters down. This must be your final stand Sister."
- Vala Glarios: "Your guards have fallen. If you too must fall, exact a grievous price."
- Vala Glarios: "Specters destroyed. She has only herself now."
- Vala Glarios: "You stand undefended Sister. Show them how hard we can fight!"
- Parvos Granum: "Space her remains. Let them drift. A monument to her failure."
- Parvos Granum: "Ah, well. I have other, less weak, sisters."
- Parvos Granum: "Tenno, that will prove to be a costly mistake."
- Parvos Granum: "Very well, Tenno. You have my attention. So. Be. It."
- Parvos Granum: "Sisters, retrieve her corpse. Analyze this failure. Learn. Iterate."
> After your harrowing victory over [ADVERSARY NAME], Ordis recovered this forged weapon blueprint. It has been added to your Foundry. Ordis cannot wait to see it in action.
> Notice is hereby given in accordance with the provisions of our association that a partnership be formed forthwith.
> The partnership exists between [PLAYER NAME] (Party A) and [ADVERSARY NAME] (myself, Party B) by mutual consent.

> It is hereby formalized that Party B sever all ties, now and in perpetuity, with the body known as The Corpus Board (Party C), and any and all associations with Parvos Granum (Party D). Party B avows they will no longer be associated with the conduit of any Corpus business and that Party B divests themselves of any and all outstanding obligations relating to Parties C and D.
> The terms of this agreement are effective immediately.
Names are according to writer Cam Rogers:
